controls.title: Governance and responsibility
controls.procedure: Review ownership, delegated duties, and conflicts of interest; approve changes through protected review.
controls.exceptions: Record exception with risk acceptance and expiry
controls.remediation: Open tracked corrective action with owner and due date

controls.title: Internal and external communication
controls.procedure: Publish controlled operational and security communications to authorized stakeholders and retain delivery evidence.
controls.remediation: Correct notice and update communication matrix

controls.title: Risk assessment
controls.procedure: Assess abuse cases, tenant boundaries, provider dependencies, and residual risk before material release.
controls.exceptions: Risk acceptance requires named approver and expiry
controls.remediation: Track mitigation to closure or approved acceptance

controls.title: Control activities
controls.procedure: Require review, automated tests, security scans, immutable manifests, and corrective-forward migration evidence for every release.
controls.exceptions: Blocked release exception requires explicit approval
controls.remediation: Re-run failed gate or roll forward with documented fix

controls.title: Logical access
controls.procedure: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA, least privilege, server-derived tenant scope, expiring support access, and prompt offboarding.
controls.remediation: Revoke access and investigate unauthorized use

controls.title: System operations and security monitoring
controls.procedure: Monitor health, security signals, vulnerabilities, and tenant-isolation alerts; triage and retain incident evidence.
controls.exceptions: Document alert coverage gap and expiry
controls.remediation: Prioritize critical/high findings and verify closure

controls.title: Change management
controls.procedure: Build once, review protected changes, pin dependencies, scan artifacts, record approvals, and verify canary/reconciliation gates.
controls.exceptions: No emergency change may bypass retrospective review
controls.remediation: Rollback or corrective-forward with incident linkage

controls.title: Risk mitigation and recovery
controls.procedure: Test backup, restore, replay, checkpoint recovery, RLS isolation, SLOs, and corrective-forward recovery using disposable synthetic environments.
controls.exceptions: External infrastructure prerequisite gaps remain explicitly open

controls.title: Pilot availability and SLO review
controls.procedure: Review availability, latency, ingestion freshness, projection lag, and recovery objectives against the pilot SLOs.
controls.exceptions: Record error budget burn and pause criteria
